display.purpose: Hero headlines and onboarding screens only. Custom font for brand distinction.

body.purpose: All UI text. Geometric sans-serif with friendly, rounded proportions.

label.purpose: Buttons, badges, tabs, metadata. Emphasis through weight, not size.

shadows.name: subtle-lift
shadows.purpose: Default card state. Gentle lift suggesting interactivity.

shadows.name: medium-lift
shadows.purpose: Pressed cards, focused inputs, dropdown menus.

shadows.name: strong-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating dock, modals, bottom sheets. Maximum elevation.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Exit animations, dismissals, content leaving view.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button. Saffron Flame background with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F97316; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.1s; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #EA580C; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.06); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action button. Outlined with Saffron Deep text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #EA580C; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1.5px solid #FDBA74; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #FFF7ED; border-color: #EA580C; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Product display card with image, name, price, and action buttons.
components.html:
Product Name

$12.99
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FEFEFE; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.06); transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-image { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; background: #F5F5F7; } .ds-card-body { padding: 12px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: #1F2937; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-price { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #EA580C; margin: 0; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Filterable category chip. Pill shape with warm background.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #FFF7ED; color: #EA580C; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #FED7AA; } .ds-chip-active { background: #F97316; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip-active:hover { background: #EA580C; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input field with warm styling.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FEFEFE; border: 1px solid #EEEEEE; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1F2937; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9CA3AF; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #F97316; } .ds-input-error { border-color: #EF4444; }

components.name: Bottom Dock
components.description: Floating curved navigation dock, 20px radius, opaque cream surface with a 1.5px saffron gradient hairline. Active tab: Saffron Whisper pill (inset 4px vertically) + 3px Saffron Flame capsule indicator, Saffron Deep icon/label. Implemented in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (see ADR-007).
components.css: .ds-dock { position: fixed; bottom: 22px; left: 18px; right: 18px; height: 64px; background: #FEFEFE; border-radius: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; padding: 0 8px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.15); } .ds-dock::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 20px; padding: 1.5px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(249,115,22,0.30), rgba(249,115,22,0.70), rgba(249,115,22,0.30)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; } .ds-dock-item { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; width: 25%; padding: 7px 6px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dock-item-active { background: #FFF7ED; } .ds-dock-capsule { position: absolute; top: -1px; width: 20px; height: 3px; border-radius: 1.5px; background: #F97316; } .ds-dock-icon { font-size: 22px; color: #71717A; } .ds-dock-item-active .ds-dock-icon { color: #EA580C; } .ds-dock-label { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 10px; color: #71717A; } .ds-dock-item-active .ds-dock-label { color: #EA580C; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Walking into a well-stocked South Asian grocery store: warm light catching rows of colorful spice jars, vibrant packaging stacked floor to ceiling, the visual richness of turmeric gold, chili red, and saffron orange against warm neutral shelves. The interface should feel appetizing, culturally rooted, and alive with color, never sterile or clinical.

This system rejects the cold utility of generic grocery apps and the cramped, low-quality feel of typical ethnic food apps. It aims for the visual confidence of premium food brands while maintaining the warmth and approachability of a neighborhood specialty store.

The palette is warm and generous, with orange as the signature color used generously across the interface. Surfaces are lifted with visible shadows, creating a tactile, floating feel. Typography uses Poppins for its friendly, geometric character, paired with the custom White-Star display font for brand distinction.
keyCharacteristics: Warmth over minimalism: color is used generously, not rationed
Appetizing imagery first: product photography drives engagement
Lifted surfaces: cards and buttons float with visible shadows
Cultural vibrancy: visual language draws from South Asian design sensibilities

rules.name: The Generosity Rule
rules.body: Orange is used generously across the interface, not rationed as a rare accent. Its abundance is the point.

rules.name: The Warm Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Never use pure #000 or #fff. All neutrals are tinted warm toward orange/amber.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight contrast, not size alone. Never use two weights at the same size for the same role.

rules.name: The Poppins-Only Rule
rules.body: All UI text uses Poppins. White-Star is reserved for display/hero use only.

rules.name: The Lifted-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and interactive surfaces have shadows at rest. The interface feels like a collection of floating objects.

rules.name: The Shadow-Not-Elevation Rule
rules.body: On Android, prefer shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius over elevation. Elevation adds opaque backgrounds that fight translucent effects.

dos: Use orange generously across the interface
Use visible shadows on cards and interactive surfaces
Prioritize product imagery on every screen
Use Poppins for all UI text
donts: Create a cold, utilitarian, blue/white corporate palette (generic grocery app)
Use cramped layouts, low-quality imagery, or cluttered navigation (typical ethnic food app)
Use side-stripe borders (border-left/right > 1px as colored accent)
Use gradient text (background-clip: text with gradients)
Use glassmorphism as a default treatment (reserve for dock only)
